text:
mia: Heads-up: planning py/ts SDK 3.8.0 GA publish in tonight's quiet window (02:00 UTC). Includes async client default + soft deprecate sync. Any blockers?
deploy-bot: Scheduled by mia for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC -> staging then 5% canary. CI: build=passed, integ=flaky (auth-refresh intermittents).
noah: Which integ test? If it's refresh token e2e, we should add a smoke gate.
mia: It's auth/refresh-e2e on mac runners only. Proposal: proceed to canary but gate GA promotion on 1h canary + auth-smoke pass.
vika: Agree. Also please publish RC under "rc-3.8.0" dist-tag; keep "latest" pinned to 3.7.4 until GA. Add release note about KMS key name change and migration snippet.
mia: @vika please draft notes. @noah run auth smoke in staging once canary is up.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (5%). Jobs: publish-py success, publish-ts success, dist-tag update queued.
ops-bot: Reminder: customers with pinned creds flagged in watchlist: 8 customers.
noah: Auth smoke running: 30m OK, no failures, latencies normal. Posting traces to #observability.
vika: Release notes PR: https://git.internal/rn/3.8.0-rc1. Includes deprecation text and KMS migration snippet.
mia: Good. Canary 1h checkpoint required before GA. If auth errors >0.5% OR any refresh e2e fail -> rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary 1h checkpoint reached. Metrics: auth_error_rate=0.06%. Auth e2e passed.
vika: OK to schedule GA for 02:00 UTC, but set npm tag rc-3.8.0 for TS and keep latest unchanged until manual promote. For Py, upload wheels under "next".
mia: Scheduling GA publish for 02:00 UTC. Post-promote watchlist for 2h.
noah: ack.
vika: ack.
mia: Note: if we see post-promote auth regressions, we'll swap dist-tags back and cut hotfix branch per playbook.
